entities.title: zazz unit tests with real builds
entities.summary: The zazz module's tests build and run real scripts, so they need the wasm32-wasip1 target and a release build of zazz-worker; on macOS CI runs them one at a time under a 15-minute limit.
criteria: Every test in zazzled's zazz:: modules passes on macOS and Linux.
They count toward zazzled's 95% branch-coverage gate.

checks.symbol: zazz tests one at a time (macOS, 15 minute limit)
checks.command: cargo build --release -p zazz-worker && cargo test -p zazzled zazz:: -- --test-threads=1 (in macos/rust)
checks.description: Single-threaded so a test that hangs under the macOS sandbox shows up by name; the workspace tests run afterwards on both systems.
zazzled's tests and branch-coverage gate, which include these modules.
